comment: Folder-name pattern -> setup family (first match wins, case-insensitive). Matches his real folder conventions: FOUNDER_WEEK setups 1-5, '8:13 shoot' Block dirs, Real Flip Vids. STOCK pattern is listed FIRST and deliberately narrow (^stock[_-]) so it only ever matches library dirs this engine itself creates (lib/fetch_assets.py writes to <root>/video/stock_<category>/) -- it must win before 'block'/'setup' style patterns could ever coincidentally match a stock dir name.
white_sweep_comment: STOCK measured, not assumed: research/g/texture_test fixtures show a legitimately in-category bright/hazy sky or ocean-glare texture clip (luma median ~248, clip-frac 0.574) collapses to the SAME order of magnitude generic exposure/luma penalty as the PRODUCT white-sweep case (c05_over.mp4, clip-frac 0.516) -- neutral/normal qscore ratio 51.8x vs 45.5x. Texture & atmosphere is the ALLOWED subject matter for STOCK (sky/sunset, water/ocean, bokeh/light) and those are high-key by nature (sun, glare, foam, cloud-white), so the generic exposure metric would systematically nuke exactly the clips the category exists to fetch. A dim/dark night-city or concrete-texture clip does NOT trip the penalty (tested: luma 74-191, clip-frac 0.0) so neutralizing costs nothing there. Decision: STOCK is white_sweep.
